payload.summary: Three places still describe hand-editing sign-off fields now that the sign-off tool enforces content pins
payload.detail: The note inside data/forms-content-review.json, the developer-area sign-off queue page text, and the MHA section review sheet header still tell a reviewer to set reviewedBy/reviewedAt by hand. A hand edit now fails the --check pin gates, so nothing slips through, but the wording should point at npm run clinical:review.
